How it works

Learn by fixing real failures

Every lab starts broken. You investigate with kubectl, fix it, and the checker tells you what still fails.

  1. 1

    It breaks

    worker 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff

    Each lab drops you into a cluster with a real-looking fault.

  2. 2

    You investigate

    $ kubectl describe pod worker

    Read events and logs, form a theory, try a fix.

  3. 3

    The checker answers

    ✓ 2 of 2 tasks pass

    Auto-checks tell you exactly what still fails, then a debrief explains why.
